title: Supplement Depreciation Already Paid — Insurance Claim Services Dwelling Release
content:
**Rule.** In the insured's dwelling release on an Insurance Claim Services file, the supplement depreciation already paid is set as follows: when the supplement carrier payments on the dwelling coverage reach the dwelling supplement approvals, the whole depreciation withheld on those approvals, because the carrier has paid it with the supplement; when they exceed the supplement approvals less their depreciation withheld but fall short of the approvals, the supplement payments less that figure, because the carrier has paid that part of the withheld depreciation; otherwise nothing.

Records: the carrier's supplement approvals on the dwelling coverage (amounts and depreciation withheld) and the carrier payments of type supplement received on the dwelling coverage.

## Bands (hypothetical: dwelling supplement approvals 5600.00 with 900.00 withheld, so 4700.00 net)

| Supplement payments on the dwelling coverage | Depreciation already paid |
|---|---|
| 5600.00 or more (reach the approvals) | 900.00, the whole withheld amount |
| 5100.00 (above 4700.00, below 5600.00) | 400.00 |
| 4700.00 (not above the net figure) | nothing |
| 3000.00 | nothing |

With no dwelling supplement approval and no withheld depreciation, payments reach the (zero) approvals and the amount already paid is the withheld depreciation on them, 0.00.
